title: Confirm scope and custody
action: Reconcile up to 25 server entries and M365/Entra objects, MPC/SAGIS grouping, data volume and data owner. Establish controlled original inventory and all ownership/support entitlements.
output: Inventory version, approved protected scope, entitlement and account handover

title: Measure the source estate
action: Measure daily changed data, actual repository availability/compatibility, network throughput and allowed production windows. Update model inputs and retain observed units and timestamps.
output: Measurement period, tool output, workload/speed/capacity values and revised scenario

title: Approve the design
action: Agree workload tiers, RPO/RTO, retention, local/off-site paths, recovery dependency order, immutable/DRaaS options, escalation and end-of-term rights.
output: Signed design decisions, sources and selected quote schedule

title: Commission isolated administration
action: Establish individual MFA-protected admin identities, least privilege, logs and MPC revocation. Verify vendor credential infrastructure has no synchronised credentials or persistent trust into MPC.
output: Approved access design, identity/permission review and actual revocation demonstration

title: Seed and verify protection
action: Complete initial local/off-site server copies and required SaaS/Entra scope, validate recoverable chains and record failed/excluded work with assigned corrections.
sourceLocator: RFP Deliverables; A2 Q28, Q83, Q97
output: Actual job reports, original recovery-point times, error outcomes and corrected reruns

title: Exercise ordinary restores
action: Recover selected file, database/application and virtual workload examples against agreed scope. Verify data/application usability and dependency order.
sourceLocator: RFP Technical Requirements; A2 Q20, Q26, Q32
owner: Prime recovery lead + MPC system owners
output: Original point IDs, start/end times, usable-data checks and owner result

title: Demonstrate bare-metal recovery
action: Perform the required complete physical-server recovery cycle to an agreed isolated target; demonstrate boot, service/data usability and measured recovery age/time.
output: Source/target identification, recovery chain, actual measured result and defect resolution

title: Demonstrate SaaS and identity restoration
action: Show agreed M365 object recovery and applicable Entra configuration recovery using the quoted product's supported route; preserve tenant/admin control.
output: Covered-object matrix, source points, restored state and role/permission checks

title: Confirm monitoring and incident routing
action: Show failed/missed/delayed/incomplete job alerts, named 24x7 contact and dual phone/email reporting. Apply the shortest applicable notification clock.
output: Observed alert path, escalation/notification timestamps, monthly report example

title: Rehearse hurricane readiness
action: Use an agreed exercise trigger and impact time. Verify complete/equivalent point across all covered workloads, track completion relative to impact−24h and disclose exceptions.
output: Trigger/impact assumptions, complete workload checklist, actual point verification and written completion record

title: Train and accept
action: Train three MPC staff on daily review, restore, escalation, access/ownership, reporting and emergency/exit procedures. Correct acceptance defects before sign-off.
owner: Prime training lead + three MPC staff
output: Attendance, reusable operating materials, completed exercises and resolved defect list

title: Enter service and preserve exit
action: Retire legacy operational backup only after enough successful new cycles and recovery validation. Maintain MPC legacy media custody, periodic exercises, monthly reporting and documented transfer/export/deletion.
sourceLocator: A2 Q19, Q32, Q100; RFP Service Levels
output: Cutover approval, continuing service schedule, retained legacy obligations and complete exit procedure
